en: Vintage sepia postcard with floral and pine-cone decorative borders. The main image shows a forested hilly landscape with a small settlement, including several houses and a church with a bulbous baroque-style tower. To the right, in a circular inset, is a large multi‑story villa-like building labeled as a sanatorium. At the bottom, ornate script reads "Maria Grün b/Graz." Printing along the left edge notes a publisher in Graz.
